annotations.title: Argentina: rent adjustment (ICL, IPC, UVA, CER)

description: Compute an Argentine lease's rent adjustments by ICL, IPC, UVA or CER from official BCRA/INDEC data: each adjustment with factor and new rent, the current rent, the next adjustment and the legal regime of the signing date. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: GET /ar/alquiler via x402.

fecha_inicio.description: Contract start date (or last adjustment), YYYY-MM-DD.

frecuencia_meses.description: Months between adjustments: 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 or 12 (default 12 for icl, 6 otherwise).

hasta.description: Compute adjustments up to this date, YYYY-MM-DD (default today).

indice.description: Index: icl (default), ipc, uva or cer.

monto.description: Rent in ARS at the contract start (or at the last adjustment if fecha_inicio is that date).

rezago_meses.description: IPC only: months between the last CPI month used and the adjustment month (1 default, 2 when the adjustment falls before INDEC publishes).
